The Senate convened at 10:15am.

Not invoked, 53-47: Motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #548, H.R.7008, Stop Insider Trading Act.

Not invoked, 57-43: Motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #684, H.R.9340, Ratepayer Protection Act.

Invoked, 53-47: Motion to invoke cloture on Executive Calendar #912, Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor.

By voice vote, the Senate passed S. 3798 – Safe Access to Cash Act of 2026.

Confirmed by unanimous consent: PN1255-12 – Peter Lord a Career Member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Minister-Counselor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Republic of Benin PN1255-9 – Keith Heffern a Career Member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Minister-Counselor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Gabonese Republic PN1022-36 – Daniel Travis a Career Member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Counselor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Republic of Sierra Leone PN1022-39 – Henry Wooster a Career Member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Minister-Counselor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Republic of Kenya PN1021-4 – Joshua Harris a Career Member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Minister-Counselor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to Malaysia PN1255-15 – Nutan Patel to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Republic of Cabo Verde PN1255-7 – Steven Gillen a Career Member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Counselor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Kyrgyz Republic PN1255-8 – Charles Goodman III a Career Member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Counselor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Togolese Republic PN1255-13 – John McIntyre a Career Member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Minister-Counselor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Republic of Malawi PN1255-6 – Natasha Franceschi a Career Member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Minister-Counselor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Republic of Nicaragua.

Confirmed, 47-41: Confirmation of Executive Calendar #912, Keith Sonderling to be Secretary of Labor.

Leader Thune filed cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #453, H.R.2347, legislative vehicle for Permitting Reform.

Military Promotion Confirmed by Unanimous Consent: Executive Cal. #913.

The Senate adjourned at 11:25pm.

The Senate convened at 10:00am.

The Senate agreed to S.Res. 917, expressing support for the designation of September as Dystonia Awareness Month to promote public awareness and understanding of dystonia.

Not agreed to, 48-51: Motion to proceed to Cal. #456, S.J.Res.197, Baldwin Obamacare Exchange Standards CRA.

Not agreed to, 47-51: Motion to discharge from Foreign Relations Committee, S.Res.852, Van Hollen Israel Human Rights Practices.

The Senate adjourned at 8:15pm

The Senate convened at 3:00pm.

Agreed to, 96-1: Baldwin amendment #6828 (modify the provision relating to the relationship of this Act to existing law) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Agreed to by voice vote: Scott (SC) amendment to require the disclosure of foreign financing of intercollegiate athletics (#6830) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Not agreed to, 1-94: Paul amendment to improve the bill (#6758) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Not agreed to, 42-54: Kennedy amendment to limit price increases for college athletics tickets (#6760) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026 (60-vote affirmative threshold).

Agreed to by voice vote: Moody/Blumenthal amendment to modify the prohibition on certain conference mergers and acquisitions (#6831) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Not agreed to, 49-50: Booker amendment to increase the limitation on funding for post-eligibility insurance and catastrophic injury for student athletes (#6805) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Not agreed to, 47-52: Booker amendment to establish certain standards with respect to coaches of varsity sports teams (#6835) to Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 to Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026.

Passed, 77-22: Passage of Cal. #449, S.4668, Protect College Sports Act of 2026, as amended.

Leader Thune filed cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #548, H.R.7008, Stop Insider Trading Act.

Leader Thune filed cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #684, H.R.9340, Ratepayer Protection Act.

Leader Thune filed cloture on Executive Calendar #912, Keith Sonderling to be Secretary of Labor.

The Senate will convene at 10:00am on Tuesday, September 29, 2026.

The Senate will recess from 12:30-2:15pm for the weekly party lunches.

At 2:15pm, the Senate will proceed to a roll call vote on the motion to proceed to S.J.Res.197 – A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services relating to “Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program”

Leader Thune filed cloture on the following:

  1. Motion to proceed to Cal. #548, H.R.7008, Stop Insider Trading Act.
  2. Motion to proceed to Cal. #684, H.R.9340, Ratepayer Protection Act.
  3. Executive Calendar #912, Keith Sonderling to be Secretary of Labor.

The Senate adjourned at 10:58pm.
